annotations.title: Treasury yields and the curve regime

description: US Treasury yields, the 2s10s and other spreads, and the curve regime (bull or bear, steepener or flattener) with the time it flipped. Yields are market prices: current or an hour behind according to the connected account, and a note instead of numbers without one.

fresh.description: Set true to ask for the live view of this one call, for 5 credits, where the connected account otherwise receives it an hour behind. Accepted and free where the account is already live. No effect without a key.
